title: Manual tee-shot stats (read off any app's stats screen or a scorecard)
description: Counts over the same set of rounds. Give counts or percentages (percentages need rounds and tee_shots_per_round). Only tee shots on par 4s and 5s. Fairway = on the short grass (first cut is a miss). A miss is left or right of the fairway as the app reports it; misses short of the fairway count by side if the app gives one, else leave them out.

course.description: home course id the rounds were played on (needs an emulator); all rounds on one course and tee

holes.description: driving holes the stats cover (default: every par 4/5 of that tee)

club.description: the club hit off these tees (mostly)

n_tee.description: tee shots counted (default rounds x tee_shots_per_round)

miss_left_pct.description: of all tee shots, as apps report it

tee_penalties.description: penalty strokes from tee shots (water, OB, lost, unplayable) over all the rounds

avg_drive.description: average driving distance in yards (tee to ball), as the app reports it (most drop mishits)

clubs.description: optional stock numbers per club: carry and total in yards (feeds the bag, not the likelihood)
